implementation: Environmental samples: legitimate interest (national health benefit) under NBA permit. Heritage records: explicit FPIC consent per knowledge holder plus community council endorsement.
enforcement_mechanism: consent_reference is NOT NULL on heritage_knowledge; a knowledge-led sample without one is rejected by a CHECK constraint.

implementation: The data dictionary marks every field required or optional with a stated purpose. No direct personal identifiers are collected. Holder identity is held in a separate encrypted register.
enforcement_mechanism: The schema has no column for holder name, address, contact or national ID. There is nowhere to put one.

implementation: FPIC signed before any interview, timestamped, in the holder's own language. Withdrawal possible at any time; linked records pseudonymised or deleted within 30 days.
enforcement_mechanism: CHECK (consent_date <= interview_date). Consent that is not prior fails to insert.

implementation: Community-level attribution (district, ward) by default; named attribution is an explicit opt-in field. Heritage-site coordinates blurred to ward level in public release.
enforcement_mechanism: CHECK (location_masked = 0 OR gps_precision_m >= 1000) — a record cannot claim to be masked while carrying field-precision coordinates.

implementation: Every record carries data_sensitivity (public, internal, confidential, sensitive, anonymized) and every heritage record carries a holder-assigned sensitivity_level.
evidence_artefact: data_sensitivity and sensitivity_level fields; metadata cards
enforcement_mechanism: Controlled-vocabulary CHECK constraints on both fields.

implementation: Tiered access: public, research (data access agreement), restricted (SIRDC plus community council concurrence), commercial (executed benefit-sharing agreement). AES-256 at rest and in transit for restricted material. Role-based access logging.
enforcement_mechanism: Restricted material is not present in any distributed package; separation is physical, not permission-based.

implementation: Public sequences retained indefinitely as a national asset. Restricted heritage records reviewed with communities every two years. Consent withdrawal actioned within 30 days.
enforcement_mechanism: v_withdrawal_impact lists every downstream record; the validator raises a critical failure and holds the batch until each is actioned.

implementation: Holders may request correction, restriction or deletion at any time. The process is documented in Shona and Ndebele and a named community liaison is the contact.
enforcement_mechanism: withdrawal_status and withdrawal_date on every heritage record; CHECK requires a date whenever status is withdrawn.

implementation: Suspected breach of restricted heritage material triggers notification to SIRDC as steward and to the affected community council within 72 hours, and suspension of the relevant access tier pending review.
enforcement_mechanism: Access events on restricted tiers are logged; the log is the basis of any incident review.
